standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the general statement to the irreducible case via the coproduct morphism.

core_obligations: Introduce the open subschemes U_i = X minus the union of the other components and their scheme theoretic closures X_i, check that X_i meets U_i scheme theoretically in U_i and meets U_j only set theoretically, and apply the birational-invariance lemma to the coproduct morphism to reduce to the irreducible case (proof lines 9726-9741).
In the irreducible case with generic point xi and C = X_red of multiplicity m, reduce to proving deg(E) = m deg(E|_C) (proof lines 9744-9746).

Let I be the ideal of C and e the minimal integer with I^{e+1} = 0, and argue by induction on e: for e = 0 the statement is immediate, otherwise set F = I^e as a coherent O_C-module and let X' be cut out by I^e with multiplicity m' (proof lines 9747-9756).

Take stalks at xi of the short exact sequence 0 -> F -> O_X -> O_{X'} -> 0 and use additivity and independence of lengths to obtain m = rank(F) + m', then finish the induction (proof lines 9757-9781).
proof_roadmap: Separate the components by scheme theoretic closures and reduce to the irreducible case.
Set up an induction on the nilpotency index of the ideal of the reduced structure.
Compute lengths at the generic point to relate the multiplicities.
difficulty_reason: The lemma expresses the degree of a locally free module on a proper scheme of dimension at most one as the sum over the one-dimensional irreducible components of the multiplicity times the degree of the restriction. The proof isolates each component by taking the complement of the union of the others and the scheme theoretic closure X_i of that open piece, uses the birational-invariance lemma for the coproduct morphism, and so reduces to the irreducible case (proof lines 9726-9741). There it must show deg(E) = m deg(E|_C) for the reduced structure C of multiplicity m, which it does by induction on the nilpotency index e of the ideal of C, using the short exact sequence 0 -> I^e -> O_X -> O_{X'} -> 0 and an additivity computation of lengths at the generic point (proof lines 9744-9781). H3: the reduction to components together with the nilpotency induction and the length computation is independent research-level work.
